index.intro: How old am I, exactly? Put in your date of birth for your age today in years, months and days, and how long you have to wait for the next birthday.

past.intro: Exam results, a wedding photo, a form asking your age "at the date of the incident": give both dates and see how old you were then, down to the day.

label.on: The date to look back to

difference.intro: Siblings arguing over who's older, and by how much? Put both dates of birth into this age difference calculator and it's settled to the day.

days-between-dates.intro: From today to a deadline, or across a whole year: count the days between dates, and see how many are weekdays and how many fall at the weekend.
days-between-dates.howto: Start day in, end day out

chronological-age.intro: 8;4;12 is how score sheets want it, and that's what the chronological age calculator gives: a child's age on the test date, ready to copy or print for the file.

dog-age.intro: Big dogs age faster than small ones, so times seven gets it wrong. This dog age calculator reads human years off the AAHA-published chart for your dog's adult size.

cat-age.intro: Your cat's age in human years, and the life stage vets use for it. There's no size to pick, because a cat age calculator only needs years and months.

korean-age.intro: Born late in the year? Your Korean age can be two more than your international age. The Korean age calculator shows both, with year age in between.

birthday-countdown.intro: A birthday countdown for cards, parties and plain impatience: the days left until the next one, and the day of the week it lands on.

how-old-will-i-be.intro: Planning for 2050, or for the year the mortgage ends? Pick the year to see how old you will be in it, and the exact day you reach that age.

what-year-was-i-born.intro: Someone says they're 42. What year were they born? Give the age and whether the birthday has been yet this year, and you'll get the year, or both if you're not sure.
what-year-was-i-born.howto: From an age to a year
